document_metadata.title: 1、EXT. GARDENS/ CASTLE - DAY.
document_metadata.summary: The queen, inspired by blood on snow, wishes for a child with skin white as snow, lips red as blood, hair black as raven's wings, and the rose's strength; a baby's cry follows.

entities.name: Queen admires falling snow and notices a blooming rose
entities.description: During deep winter, the Queen observes the snowfall in the castle gardens and sees a red rose blooming despite the cold, drawing her attention.

entities.name: Queen reaches for the rose and pricks her finger
entities.description: The Queen bends down toward the rose, attempts to touch or pick it, and accidentally pricks her finger on its thorn.

entities.name: Three drops of blood fall onto the snow
entities.description: As a result of the Queen pricking her finger, three drops of blood land on the snowy ground, each landing emphasized with a dramatic impact sound.

entities.name: deep winter
entities.description: A time of extreme cold and snow cover during which the Queen observes the falling snow and the anomalous blooming of a rose.

entities.name: Queen
entities.description: A royal woman who admires the falling snow, notices a blooming rose, reaches for it, and pricks her finger, causing three drops of blood to fall onto the snow.
entities.summary: A royal woman pricks her finger on a rose, spilling blood on snow; she later gives birth to Snow White, tends a magpie, and is linked to a powerful, feared figure who controls access to Snow White and may have ordered her death, while King Magnus and a navigator for the Dark Forest are also involved.

entities.name: Raven
entities.description: A bird observing the Queen as she approaches and interacts with the blooming rose in the snow-covered garden.

entities.name: Rose
entities.summary: A woman's scream prompts Eric to act; another fights Broch, while a bound woman is sold as a slave. A prisoner identifies herself to Snow White, and a village woman reveals past details, recognizing Snow White's identity.

entities.name: Queen wishes for a child with specific traits
entities.description: Inspired by the contrast of blood on snow and the black raven, the Queen silently expresses a deep desire for a child possessing qualities of purity, vitality, and strength symbolized by snow, blood, a raven, and a rose.

entities.name: Ravenna listens to military report while eating a dead songbird's heart

entities.description: A general cautiously informs Ravenna that rebel forces have begun offensive actions, including harassing supply lines and robbing pay wagons.

entities.name: Generals announce capture of two rebel leaders

document_metadata.title: 48、INT. THRONE ROOM - CASTLE - DAY.
document_metadata.summary: Queen Ravenna offers to resurrect Eric's deceased wife in exchange for capturing the escaped prisoner, exploiting his grief and desire for reunion.

entities.name: Eric enters the throne room in a drunken and disheveled state
entities.description: Eric, visibly drunk and wearing dirty, damp clothes with a bruised face, enters the throne room and observes the ravens and scullery maids before approaching Queen Ravenna.

entities.name: Ravenna questions Eric about his background and reputation
entities.description: Queen Ravenna informs Eric that her brother has described him as a widower, a drunkard, and one of the few who has survived the dark forest, establishing his notoriety.

entities.name: Ravenna tasks Eric with finding her escaped female prisoner
entities.description: Ravenna reveals that a female prisoner has escaped into the dark forest and commands Eric to locate and return her, initiating a dangerous mission.

entities.name: Eric refuses to return to the Dark Forest due to fear of death
entities.description: Eric rejects Ravenna's request, stating he has been to the Dark Forest before and will not go back, citing the extreme danger and near-certain death.

entities.name: Ravenna offers Eric a non-monetary incentive for compliance
entities.description: After Eric dismisses coin as worthless if he is dead, Ravenna hints at a reward beyond gold, suggesting personal or emotional value in exchange for his service.

entities.name: Eric questions the significance of the escaped prisoner's life
entities.description: Eric challenges Ravenna by asking why the escaped woman's life holds such value, attempting to understand the stakes behind the mission.

entities.name: Ravenna asserts authority over Eric's obedience
entities.description: Ravenna ignores Eric's defiance and declares that he will carry out her order, reinforcing her dominance in the confrontation.

entities.name: Guards threaten Eric with violence upon Ravenna's signal
entities.description: When Eric questions his obligation, Ravenna signals the guards, who draw their swords and prepare to attack, demonstrating the threat of force behind her command.

entities.name: Eric defiantly challenges Ravenna to have him killed
entities.description: Facing the armed guards, Eric looks at Ravenna and honestly begs her to kill him, showing both defiance and despair.

entities.name: Interrogation Of Eric In The Throne Room
entities.description: A formal and tense confrontation takes place in Queen Ravenna's throne room, where she questions Eric about his past and compels him to undertake a dangerous mission, surrounded by guards and onlookers.

entities.name: Ravenna

entities.name: lurchers
entities.description: Dogs that scamper about the throne room, present during Eric's arrival.

entities.name: Eric grabs Ravenna by the throat in a moment of rage
entities.description: In response to Ravenna's taunt about his beloved, Eric instinctively seizes her by the throat, prompting the courtiers to stand and guards to draw swords.

entities.name: Ravenna remains calm as Eric threatens her
entities.description: Despite being physically threatened by Eric, Ravenna shows no fear and instead raises her hand to stop the guards, demonstrating control over the situation.

entities.name: Eric releases Ravenna upon realizing her reaction
entities.description: Eric becomes unsettled by Ravenna's apparent enjoyment of his aggression and lets go of her throat, shifting from rage to discomfort.

entities.name: Ravenna offers to resurrect Eric's wife in exchange for the girl
entities.description: Ravenna leverages Eric's grief, claiming her magical power to bring his deceased wife back to life if he captures the escaped prisoner for her.

entities.name: Eric expresses doubt about the possibility of resurrection
entities.description: Eric responds to Ravenna's offer with skepticism, stating that nothing can truly bring his wife back from the dead.

entities.name: Ravenna persuades Eric with a promise of resurrection
entities.description: Ravenna closes the distance, locks eyes with Eric, and confidently asserts her ability to resurrect his wife, appealing to his deepest longing.

entities.name: Eric shows internal conflict and desire to believe Ravenna
entities.description: Though skeptical, Eric's expression reveals that he desperately wants to believe Ravenna's claim about resurrecting his wife.

entities.name: Ravenna declares the exchange as a life for a life
entities.description: Ravenna frames the bargain morally and magically, stating that one life (the escaped prisoner) will be traded for another (Eric's wife).

document_metadata.summary: Eric trains Snow White in combat, emphasizing using an opponent's strength, precise timing, and close engagement; she questions killing, he departs for Fumee, leaving her focused and contemplative.

entities.description: Eric cautions Snow White not to drink from the stream, warning that it could severely harm her, causing her to release the water and stand up.

entities.description: Eric offers Snow White his flask of mead; she reluctantly takes a sip, reacts negatively, spits most of it out, and returns the flask.

entities.description: Eric notices a long brown pellet on the ground, bends down to inspect it, identifies it as a 'fumee', and confirms it is animal dung by smelling it.

entities.description: After analyzing the droppings and sensing threat, Eric tells Snow White to remain in place while he moves ahead into the trees to track potential danger.

entities.description: While tracking through the forest, Eric hears the wind calling his name, saying 'Sara', which causes him to stop and look toward a rocky outcropping.

entities.description: An apparition of Sara emerges from behind a tree near a rocky outcrop, appearing beautiful and spectral, and speaks to Eric, drawing him toward her.

entities.description: After hearing Eric's voice, Snow White notices his footprints and follows them into the deeper forest to locate him.

entities.description: Seeing Eric being lured into danger, Snow White hits him behind the knees with a piece of wood, causing him to fall to the ground.

entities.description: After knocking Eric down, Snow White drags him away from the danger; when he resists, she jumps on top of him and shouts that the vision of Sara is not real.

entities.name: Eric breaks down after realizing the illusion
entities.description: Eric, overwhelmed by guilt and the failed vision of Sara, sits up exhausted, pours the last drop of mead into his mouth, and discards the empty flask, appearing defeated.

entities.description: After calming Eric and witnessing his emotional collapse, Snow White watches him with pity and concern, recognizing his inner turmoil.

document_metadata.title: 79、EXT. RIVER BANK - DAY.
document_metadata.summary: Snow White insists on saving both herself and Eric; the dwarves agree to help as the Queen's riders approach, prompting a hasty escape.

entities.name: Snow White gives the huntsman a look to express concern
entities.description: Snow White silently communicates her worry or disapproval to the huntsman through a meaningful glance, prompting a response from him.

entities.name: Huntsman calms Snow White with a reassuring look
entities.description: In response to Snow White's concern, the huntsman returns a calming gaze that pacifies her without speaking.

entities.name: Nion expresses disapproval of Eric's behavior
entities.description: Nion verbally criticizes Eric by comparing him to a 'ruttish swine' and physically smacks him as a reprimand.

entities.name: Quert assists his father Muir in approaching Snow White
entities.description: Upon being called, Quert quickly responds and helps his aging father Muir move toward Snow White.

entities.name: Muir touches Snow White's face and experiences an emotional shift
entities.description: When Muir makes physical contact with Snow White, he undergoes a noticeable change in demeanor, softening and showing a faint smile.

entities.name: Coll and Duir debate leaving Snow White and the huntsman to die
entities.description: Coll suggests abandoning Snow White and Eric to rot, while Duir proposes killing Eric and leaving Snow White to die, revealing their harsh but comradely dynamic.

entities.name: Muir declares Snow White as destined
entities.description: Muir emphatically interrupts the group's discussion to assert that Snow White has a prophesied or fated role, demanding silence and respect.

entities.name: Gus expresses awe and admiration for Snow White
entities.description: Gus, visibly smitten, affirms Muir's claim about Snow White's destiny with emotional conviction.

entities.name: Beith questions Gus's loyalty to the group
entities.description: Beith challenges Gus's sudden devotion to Snow White by asking if he is truly committed to their cause.

entities.name: Snow White reveals her royal lineage to the dwarves
entities.description: Snow White identifies herself as the daughter of King Magnus, which impresses the group and shifts their perception of her importance.

entities.name: Snow White offers the dwarves payment for escorting her to the Duke's castle
entities.description: Snow White promises each dwarf a reward equal to their body weight in gold if they accompany her and Eric to the Duke's castle.

entities.name: Dwarves exchange glances while mentally assessing their value
entities.description: Upon hearing the offer of payment by weight, the dwarves look at one another, silently evaluating their physical sizes and potential rewards.

entities.name: Eric protests the disparity in reward offers
entities.description: Eric expresses indignation that Snow White offered him less money than she is now offering the dwarves.

entities.name: Beith mocks the huntsman's reliance on others
entities.description: Beith sarcastically comments on the huntsman's claim of independence by pointing out that he was already lost before finding the dwarves.

entities.name: Duir whispers a boastful remark to Coll about earning more gold
entities.description: Duir quietly tells Coll that he will receive a larger share of gold due to his size, prompting a practical rebuttal about expenses.

entities.name: Dwarves' Council Meeting In The Forest Hideout
entities.description: A gathering of the dwarf resistance group in their hidden woodland refuge to discuss the fate of Snow White and the huntsman, make decisions, and react to revelations about her identity and destiny.
entities.summary: A gathering of the dwarf resistance group in their hidden woodland refuge to discuss the fate of Snow White and the huntsman, make decisions, and react to revelations about her identity and destiny.

entities.name: forest hideout
entities.description: A concealed setting in the woods where the dwarves hold their council and interact with Snow White and the huntsman.

entities.name: Snow White
entities.description: A royal figure who reveals her lineage and seeks protection from the dwarves to reach the Duke's castle.
entities.summary: Snow White, a young princess celebrated for her beauty and defiant spirit, shows compassion by rescuing a wounded magpie, interacts playfully yet defiantly with William, and rushes through a seaside village and castle, demonstrating courage and empathy.

entities.name: Huntsman
entities.description: A protector figure accompanying Snow White, who has a tense dynamic with the dwarves and resists reliance on others.
entities.summary: Eric is a hunter and protector of Snow White, addressed by various titles, involved in tense interactions with dwarves, and targeted by Finn's hatchet during a confrontation.

entities.name: Eric
entities.description: A member of the group who expresses skepticism and resistance toward helping Snow White and the huntsman.
entities.summary: Various narrators provide voice-over commentary on key events involving Snow White, Ravenna, and other characters, while a drunken huntsman intervenes in a confrontation and a man stirs in the woods upon hearing a scream.

entities.name: Nion
entities.description: A disapproving figure who physically reprimands Eric for his behavior and shows moral judgment.
entities.summary: A dwarf supremacist and Beith's ally, he enforces authority through violence, disapproving of Eric's actions, participates in the forest journey, shares rum with Gort, and shows hesitation in freeing the huntsman while complaining about fairy music.

entities.name: Muir
entities.description: The spiritual leader of the dwarf group who declares Snow White as destined after a personal emotional shift.
entities.summary: A blind dwarf elder, guided by spiritual insight and facial vibrations, recognizes Snow White as the prophesied redeemer destined to heal the Enchanted Forest, urging his people to embrace sacrifice and reclaim their pride.

entities.name: Quert
entities.description: Muir's son who assists his father in approaching Snow White.
entities.summary: Muir's son, a blind dwarf, assists his father, sings at his request, mourns during Gus's funeral, and is present during key moments including Snow White's awakening and the white hart's appearance, while also questioning promised gold and showing familial affection.

entities.name: Gort
entities.description: A member of the dwarf group who questions the decision regarding Snow White and seeks clarification on reward.
entities.summary: Dwarfs express doubt and concern over Snow White's role and destiny, seek clarification on rewards, react to forest sounds with moss earplugs, show unease, and one shares rum while demanding louder music before confronting Eric.

entities.name: Coll
entities.description: A dwarf with a persistent cough who debates leaving Snow White and the huntsman to die, showing a complex camaraderie with Duir.
entities.summary: A dwarf involved in key moments with Duir, including cave exploration, combat against Aldan and William, and shared memories of Tylweth Gate, showing loyalty and camaraderie amidst conflict.

entities.name: Duir
entities.description: A boastful dwarf who suggests violent options and whispers competitively to Coll about earning more gold.
entities.summary: A boastful dwarf involved in combat, cave exploration, and group decisions, interacting with Coll and others during missions and battles.

entities.name: Beith
entities.description: A critical and mocking member of the dwarf group who challenges both Eric and the huntsman's actions.
entities.summary: A group of dwarves, including a leader, a gruff member, a critic, and others, interact with Eric, the huntsman, and Snow White in the Enchanted Forest, participating in camp life and rituals like Gus's funeral.

entities.name: Gus
entities.description: A dwarf visibly smitten with Snow White, expressing admiration and immediate belief in her destiny.
entities.summary: A dwarf among Snow White's captors, he shows genuine admiration for her, disarms her with sincerity, frees her from bonds, aids her during attacks, plays fiddle, dances with her, and supports Muir's declaration upon awakening.

entities.name: Queen
entities.summary: A royal woman pricks her finger on a rose, spilling blood on snow; she later gives birth to Snow White, tends a magpie, and is linked to a powerful, feared figure who controls access to Snow White and may have ordered her death, while King Magnus and a navigator for the Dark Forest are also involved.

entities.name: Dwarves
entities.summary: A group of small humanoids hides with Eric and Snow White as Duir and Coll enter a cave. Seven battle-hardened dwarves, emotionally affected by Gus's death, later storm a gatehouse, overpowering guards despite being outnumbered.

entities.name: Duke'S Castle
entities.description: A destination associated with safety, authority, and potential reward, where Snow White intends to go for protection.
entities.summary:
A fortress or stronghold associated with the Duke, intended as a refuge for Snow White due to the presence of an army.
A destination associated with safety, authority, and potential reward, where Snow White intends to go for protection.

entities.name: Beith agrees to escort Snow White but initially refuses to take the huntsman
entities.description: Beith consents to help Snow White reach her destination but explicitly excludes the huntsman from their protection, showing distrust toward him.

entities.name: Snow White insists that both she and the huntsman be taken together
entities.description: Snow White demonstrates loyalty by refusing to leave without the huntsman, demanding that the dwarves protect them both.

entities.name: Duir alerts the group to approaching riders on the distant hill
entities.description: Duir spots a group of mounted figures silhouetted against the hilltop and warns the others, prompting immediate concern.

entities.name: Eric identifies the approaching riders as the Queen's men
entities.description: Eric informs Beith that the riders are agents of the Queen, raising the urgency of their situation and the need for a quick decision.

entities.name: Beith underestimates the threat until more riders appear on the hill
entities.description: Initially dismissive of the danger, Beith changes his stance when the number of enemy riders visibly increases, revealing the severity of the threat.

entities.name: Beith orders the group to move out and abandon the huntsman
entities.description: Faced with overwhelming danger, Beith commands the dwarves to flee immediately and leaves the decision to cut down the huntsman to Nion.

entities.name: Nion cuts the huntsman free from his bindings
entities.description: In response to Beith's order, Nion severs the rope restraining the huntsman, allowing him to escape with the group.

entities.name: Gus gently lifts Snow White to carry her down the hill
entities.description: Gus assists Snow White by lifting her carefully, indicating care and protection as the group flees the approaching threat.

entities.name: The group flees down the hill to escape the Queen's riders
entities.description: The entire party, including Snow White, the huntsman, and the dwarves, begins a rapid retreat down the hill to avoid capture or confrontation.

document_metadata.title: 94、EXT. ENCHANTED FOREST - DAY.
document_metadata.summary: Dwarves debate risking their lives for Snow White; Muir inspires them by invoking legend and honor, convincing some to fight for redemption despite fear and loss.

entities.name: Eric returns to the group while bleeding from his wounds
entities.description: Eric, injured and still bleeding, rushes back through the forest to rejoin Snow White and the seven dwarves who are gathered around Gus's body.

entities.name: William introduces himself as Duke Hammond's son
entities.description: When Eric questions William's identity, William responds directly, revealing that he is the son of Duke Hammond and noting that Eric looks familiar.

entities.name: Eric challenges William's presence with the Queen's men
entities.description: Eric questions why the Duke's son is traveling with the Queen's soldiers, expressing suspicion about William's intentions and motives.

entities.name: William declares his intent to protect the princess
entities.description: William states that he was searching for the princess not to harm her, but to ensure her safety, positioning himself as a protector.

entities.name: Eric asserts his role in bringing the princess to safety
entities.description: Eric responds to William's claim by emphasizing that he is the one who successfully escorted the princess thus far, asserting his authority and experience.

entities.name: William attempts to take charge of the princess's protection
entities.description: William expresses gratitude for Eric's help but declares that he will now assume responsibility for the princess's safety.

entities.name: Eric mocks William's authority and challenges his maturity
entities.description: Eric dismisses William's attempt to give orders, sarcastically suggesting he is too young and inexperienced to command him.

entities.name: William and Eric draw weapons in confrontation
entities.description: Offended by Eric's insult, William draws his sword; Eric responds by drawing his axe, escalating the tension between them.

entities.name: Snow White intervenes to stop the conflict
entities.description: Snow White turns from mourning Gus and tells Eric to leave William alone, declaring that William is a friend and de-escalating the confrontation.

entities.name: Snow White mourns Gus's death with tears and prayer
entities.description: Snow White remains bowed over Gus's body, sobbing and participating in a low chant as part of a mourning ritual after his death.

entities.name: Nion ends the prayer and calls for a private meeting
entities.description: After spitting in anger, Nion declares that the group needs to convene and leads them a short distance away to discuss matters privately.

entities.name: Funeral Ceremony For Gus In The Enchanted Forest
entities.description: A solemn gathering of Snow White and the seven dwarves around Gus's body, involving a low prayer chant and expressions of grief to honor the fallen companion.
entities.summary: A solemn gathering of Snow White and the seven dwarves around Gus's body, involving a low prayer chant and expressions of grief to honor the fallen companion.

entities.name: Emergency Council Among Snow White'S Companions
entities.description: Following the mourning ritual, the group moves to a private location to convene and discuss their next steps in response to recent events and tensions.
entities.summary: Following the mourning ritual, the group moves to a private location to convene and discuss their next steps in response to recent events and tensions.

entities.name: forest
entities.description: A wooded area where Eric travels back to rejoin the group after being wounded.

entities.name: Gus's body
entities.description: The site where Snow White and the dwarves are gathered, serving as the focal point for the mourning ritual.

entities.name: Eric
entities.description: A wounded man who returns to the group after being injured, involved in protecting Snow White and confronting William.
entities.summary: Various narrators provide voice-over commentary on key events involving Snow White, Ravenna, and other characters, while a drunken huntsman intervenes in a confrontation and a man stirs in the woods upon hearing a scream.

entities.name: William
entities.description: The son of Duke Hammond who arrives with the Queen's men, claiming his intent to protect the princess.
entities.summary: A boy hesitates to help an injured magpie as Snow White carries it to a castle; together they pick an apple, evade guards, and reunite amid a siege, while the Queen's fragile state is noted.

entities.name: Snow White
entities.description: The princess who is the subject of protection efforts and who mourns the death of Gus.
entities.summary: Snow White, a young princess celebrated for her beauty and defiant spirit, shows compassion by rescuing a wounded magpie, interacts playfully yet defiantly with William, and rushes through a seaside village and castle, demonstrating courage and empathy.

entities.name: Beith
entities.description: One of Snow White's companions present during the confrontation between Eric and William.
entities.summary: A group of dwarves, including a leader, a gruff member, a critic, and others, interact with Eric, the huntsman, and Snow White in the Enchanted Forest, participating in camp life and rituals like Gus's funeral.

entities.name: Nion
entities.description: A member of Snow White's companions who ends the prayer and calls for a private meeting.
entities.summary: A dwarf supremacist and Beith's ally, he enforces authority through violence, disapproving of Eric's actions, participates in the forest journey, shares rum with Gort, and shows hesitation in freeing the huntsman while complaining about fairy music.

entities.name: Gus
entities.description: A fallen companion whose body is mourned by the group during a prayer ritual.
entities.summary: A dwarf among Snow White's captors, he shows genuine admiration for her, disarms her with sincerity, frees her from bonds, aids her during attacks, plays fiddle, dances with her, and supports Muir's declaration upon awakening.

entities.name: Duke Hammond
entities.summary: William's father, a noble ruler and loyal ally to King Magnus, leads resistance against invaders, prioritizing his son's safety and the survival of their cause amid battle and political turmoil.

entities.name: sword
entities.description: A weapon drawn by William during his confrontation with Eric.

entities.name: axe
entities.description: A weapon drawn by Eric during his confrontation with William.

entities.name: Nion expresses skepticism about dwarves aiding humans
entities.description: Nion voices his belief that dwarves always suffer when getting involved with human affairs, questioning the value of risking their lives for Snow White.

entities.name: Gort states reluctance to risk his life for Snow White
entities.description: Gort declares that while he has no ill will toward Snow White, he is not willing to die for her, referencing Gus's death as a cautionary example.

entities.name: Duir and Coll whisper about whether they will fight the Queen
entities.description: Duir quietly asks Coll if their group is still planning to oppose the Queen, indicating uncertainty among the dwarves about their course of action.

entities.name: Quert inquires about the gold promised by Duke Hammond
entities.description: Quert raises the question of the gold reward previously promised to them, showing concern for material compensation.

entities.name: Nion dismisses gold as worthless if they are dead
entities.description: Nion rebukes Quert by emphasizing that gold has no value if they are killed for supporting Snow White, highlighting the stakes of their decision.

entities.name: Beith agrees that the Queen will punish them for helping Snow White
entities.description: Beith supports Nion's fear by affirming that the Queen will retaliate brutally against them for their involvement with her stepdaughter.

entities.name: Muir defends Snow White as the prophesied redeemer
entities.description: Muir argues that Snow White is the legendary figure destined to heal the land, citing the White Hart's blessing and their ancient myths.

entities.name: Muir challenges the dwarves to reclaim their pride through sacrifice
entities.description: Muir delivers a passionate speech urging the dwarves to rise above their current degradation and fight for a chance to become honorable again.

entities.name: Muir declares willingness to die for Snow White
entities.description: Muir affirms that he is ready to give his life for Snow White, framing it as a noble cause worth dying for.

entities.name: Quert shows affection to his father after the discussion
entities.description: After Muir's speech, Quert embraces his father by putting an arm around him and kissing his forehead, expressing emotional support.

entities.name: Beith and Gort silently agree to support Muir's stance
entities.description: Beith and Gort exchange a knowing nod and smile, indicating their decision to stand with Muir in supporting Snow White despite earlier doubts.

entities.name: Gort
entities.description: A dwarf who is reluctant to risk his life for Snow White and voices skepticism about her significance.
entities.summary: Dwarfs express doubt and concern over Snow White's role and destiny, seek clarification on rewards, react to forest sounds with moss earplugs, show unease, and one shares rum while demanding louder music before confronting Eric.

entities.name: Duir
entities.description: A dwarf who whispers to Coll about whether they will fight the Queen, showing uncertainty about their next actions.
entities.summary: A boastful dwarf involved in combat, cave exploration, and group decisions, interacting with Coll and others during missions and battles.

entities.name: Coll
entities.description: A dwarf who responds to Duir's whisper, indicating uncertainty about whether they will oppose the Queen.
entities.summary: A dwarf involved in key moments with Duir, including cave exploration, combat against Aldan and William, and shared memories of Tylweth Gate, showing loyalty and camaraderie amidst conflict.

entities.name: Quert
entities.description: A dwarf who inquires about the gold promised by Duke Hammond and later shows affection to his father after the discussion.
entities.summary: Muir's son, a blind dwarf, assists his father, sings at his request, mourns during Gus's funeral, and is present during key moments including Snow White's awakening and the white hart's appearance, while also questioning promised gold and showing familial affection.

entities.name: Muir
entities.description: A dwarf who defends Snow White as the prophesied redeemer and calls on the others to reclaim their pride through sacrifice.
entities.summary: A blind dwarf elder, guided by spiritual insight and facial vibrations, recognizes Snow White as the prophesied redeemer destined to heal the Enchanted Forest, urging his people to embrace sacrifice and reclaim their pride.

entities.name: Queen
entities.summary: A royal woman pricks her finger on a rose, spilling blood on snow; she later gives birth to Snow White, tends a magpie, and is linked to a powerful, feared figure who controls access to Snow White and may have ordered her death, while King Magnus and a navigator for the Dark Forest are also involved.

entities.name: White Hart
entities.summary: A majestic mystical deer that bows before Snow White and emits golden light, signifying her role as the chosen one.

entities.name: Redeemer
entities.description: A prophesied figure from dwarf legends who is destined to heal the land and restore balance.
entities.summary: A prophesied figure from dwarf legends who is destined to heal the land and restore balance.

entities.name: gold
entities.description: A promised reward from Duke Hammond that Quert inquires about, representing material incentive for the dwarves' involvement.

document_metadata.title: 105、INT. GENERAL'S TENT - NIGHT.
document_metadata.summary: Snow White, armored and mounted, leads her army from the castle with Eric by her side, as the Duke's forces surge forward in a fiery advance across the valley.

entities.description: The Mirror Man laughs and declares his loyalty as he witnesses Ravenna's successful restoration of youth and power.

entities.name: Ravenna
entities.description: The queen who regains her youth and strength by draining the life force from the Crones, preparing herself for an upcoming battle.
entities.summary: A beautiful woman captivates King Magnus, marries him, and kills him in retribution for her people's destruction, later revealed as Snow White's stepmother and Finn's sister, joining Finn and the knights.

entities.name: The Mirror Man
entities.description: A sentient mirror entity who serves Ravenna and expresses joy at her rejuvenation.
entities.summary: A sentient supernatural entity within a magic mirror serves Ravenna, revealing Snow White's greater beauty, mocking Ravenna's desperation, and reacting to her waning powers and rejuvenation.

entities.name: Eric
entities.description: A warrior who bows before Snow White, showing loyalty and pride in her leadership.
entities.summary: Various narrators provide voice-over commentary on key events involving Snow White, Ravenna, and other characters, while a drunken huntsman intervenes in a confrontation and a man stirs in the woods upon hearing a scream.

entities.name: Beith
entities.description: One of the dwarves who bows before Snow White as a sign of allegiance.
entities.summary: A group of dwarves, including a leader, a gruff member, a critic, and others, interact with Eric, the huntsman, and Snow White in the Enchanted Forest, participating in camp life and rituals like Gus's funeral.

entities.name: Muir
entities.description: One of the dwarves who bows before Snow White, accompanied by his son Quert.
entities.summary: A blind dwarf elder, guided by spiritual insight and facial vibrations, recognizes Snow White as the prophesied redeemer destined to heal the Enchanted Forest, urging his people to embrace sacrifice and reclaim their pride.

entities.name: Quert
entities.description: Son of Muir and one of the dwarves who bows before Snow White.
entities.summary: Muir's son, a blind dwarf, assists his father, sings at his request, mourns during Gus's funeral, and is present during key moments including Snow White's awakening and the white hart's appearance, while also questioning promised gold and showing familial affection.

entities.name: Coll
entities.description: One of the dwarves who bows before Snow White as a gesture of loyalty.
entities.summary: A dwarf involved in key moments with Duir, including cave exploration, combat against Aldan and William, and shared memories of Tylweth Gate, showing loyalty and camaraderie amidst conflict.

entities.name: Duir
entities.description: One of the dwarves who bows before Snow White in a ceremony of allegiance.
entities.summary: A boastful dwarf involved in combat, cave exploration, and group decisions, interacting with Coll and others during missions and battles.

entities.name: Gort
entities.description: One of the dwarves who bows before Snow White, completing the act of fealty.
entities.summary: Dwarfs express doubt and concern over Snow White's role and destiny, seek clarification on rewards, react to forest sounds with moss earplugs, show unease, and one shares rum while demanding louder music before confronting Eric.

entities.name: Nion
entities.description: One of the dwarves who bows before Snow White, joining the others in pledging loyalty.
entities.summary: A dwarf supremacist and Beith's ally, he enforces authority through violence, disapproving of Eric's actions, participates in the forest journey, shares rum with Gort, and shows hesitation in freeing the huntsman while complaining about fairy music.

entities.name: William
entities.description: A lord who follows Duke Hammond in bowing before Snow White, signaling allegiance.
entities.summary: A boy hesitates to help an injured magpie as Snow White carries it to a castle; together they pick an apple, evade guards, and reunite amid a siege, while the Queen's fragile state is noted.

entities.name: Duke Hammond
entities.description: A nobleman who initiates the gesture of bowing before Snow White, setting an example for others.
entities.summary: William's father, a noble ruler and loyal ally to King Magnus, leads resistance against invaders, prioritizing his son's safety and the survival of their cause amid battle and political turmoil.

entities.name: Crones
entities.description: Supernatural beings who have transferred their youth to Ravenna, now left aged and weakened on the floor of the Mirror Chamber.

entities.name: Magic Mirror
entities.description: A magical reflective surface inhabited by the Mirror Man, used by Ravenna to observe and affirm her restored youth.
entities.summary:
A magical reflective surface that transforms, distorts, and communicates, serving as a conduit for confrontation and revelation.

entities.name: Eric compliments Snow White on her armor
entities.description: Just before rejoining the ranks, Eric tells Snow White she looks fetching in her chain mail, adding a personal and tender note to their interaction.

entities.description: Duke Hammond shouts at the top of his voice, urging the riders forward and fueling the army's vengeful momentum as they charge out of the castle.

entities.summary: Snow White, a young princess celebrated for her beauty and defiant spirit, shows compassion by rescuing a wounded magpie, interacts playfully yet defiantly with William, and rushes through a seaside village and castle, demonstrating courage and empathy.

document_metadata.title: 136、INT. MIRROR CHAMBER - DAY.
document_metadata.summary: Snow White blocks Ravenna's attack, stabs her with her own dagger, triggering Ravenna's rapid aging and death as the dark magic shatters.

entities.name: Ravenna attacks Snow White by grabbing her throat
entities.description: Ravenna physically assaults Snow White by seizing her by the throat and applying pressure, causing Snow White to choke.

entities.description: Ravenna unsheathes her dagger, straddles Snow White, and raises the weapon above her head, visibly anticipating the act of killing her.

entities.description: Ravenna plunges the dagger toward Snow White while chanting a spell, 'By fairest blood it is done!', completing the ritualistic act of sacrifice.

entities.name: Ravenna
entities.description: A powerful and vengeful queen who seeks to maintain her power by killing Snow White through a ritualistic dagger strike.
entities.summary: A beautiful woman captivates King Magnus, marries him, and kills him in retribution for her people's destruction, later revealed as Snow White's stepmother and Finn's sister, joining Finn and the knights.

entities.name: Snow White
entities.description: A young woman targeted by Ravenna, struggling to survive the attack and reach her weapon in a desperate fight for her life.
entities.summary: Snow White, a young princess celebrated for her beauty and defiant spirit, shows compassion by rescuing a wounded magpie, interacts playfully yet defiantly with William, and rushes through a seaside village and castle, demonstrating courage and empathy.

entities.name: Eric
entities.description: A witness to the attack on Snow White, visibly overcome with despair as he watches the fatal strike unfold.
entities.summary: Various narrators provide voice-over commentary on key events involving Snow White, Ravenna, and other characters, while a drunken huntsman intervenes in a confrontation and a man stirs in the woods upon hearing a scream.

entities.name: dagger

entities.name: sword
entities.description: A weapon that Snow White attempts to reach during the attack, symbolizing her last chance at self-defense.

entities.name: fairest blood
entities.description: A magical concept referenced in Ravenna's incantation, signifying the ritualistic necessity of Snow White's death to fulfill a supernatural transformation or prophecy.

entities.name: Snow White blocks Ravenna's strike and stabs her with her own dagger
entities.description: In a swift countermove, Snow White defends herself by blocking Ravenna's attack, seizes the dagger, and plunges it into Ravenna's chest, using the technique taught by the huntsman.

entities.name: Snow White whispers 'By fairest blood... it is undone!' to Ravenna
entities.description: After stabbing Ravenna, Snow White whispers a decisive phrase to her, signifying the fulfillment of a prophecy tied to the power of 'fairest blood'.

entities.name: Three drops of Ravenna's blood fall onto Snow White's armor

entities.name: Ravenna pulls out the dagger and begins rapidly aging
entities.description: After being stabbed, Ravenna removes the dagger from her chest and immediately begins to age at an accelerated rate, losing her youth and strength.

entities.name: Ravenna collapses and dies on the stone floor below the mirror
entities.description: Overcome by the effects of aging and injury, Ravenna's body fails, and she slumps to the floor beneath the mirror, dying in despair.

entities.description: In her dying breath, Ravenna gazes at the mirror above her, gasping and reaching out as if seeking recognition, comfort, or salvation, but receives none.

entities.description: Following Ravenna's death, the dark magical shards that had enclosed the space begin to break apart and collapse to the floor, symbolizing the end of her reign.
